# CartGain

> Cart recovery and AI bargaining software for Shopify and WooCommerce merchants.

CartGain helps merchants recover abandoned carts with consent-gated email and WhatsApp reminders, and answer shopper price objections with an AI shopkeeper that stays inside merchant-set pricing rules.

## Key features

- Abandoned-cart recovery with explicit email and WhatsApp opt-in, quiet hours, tracked links, and refund-aware analytics
- AI bargaining with server-authoritative pricing, merchant-controlled minimum prices, and real discount codes
- Shopify and WooCommerce integrations
- Storefront experience settings for shopkeeper personality, invitation design, and published variants
- Merchant analytics for recovery revenue, bargain funnels, and experiment cohorts
